items.title: UPS reorganization prioritizes global logistics over parcel delivery
items.summary: UPS said it is reorganizing how it operates under a new set of global standards that emphasizes its cross-border logistics capabilities rather than its domestic parcel business. items.title: UPS Rejiggers Operating Model, Names Chief Global Operations Officer
items.summary: The company shook up its executive roles as part of the new model, naming the head of its U.S. business to lead its global operations, among other appointments.

items.title: A $2 Billion Reason to Buy UPS Stock
items.summary: UPS stock climbed after the company said it was investing more than $2 billion across its International, Healthcare, and Supply Chain Solutions businesses.

items.title: 3 Large-Cap Stocks with Questionable Fundamentals
items.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.

items.title: Wall Street Is Sleeping on These 3 Ultra-High-Yield Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Three famous dividend names trade well below their five-year highs while their CEOs publicly draw lines in the sand around the payout. Whether the cash flow actually backs that confidence is a different question entirely.

items.title: 3 Cash-Producing Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: While strong cash flow is a key indicator of stability, it doesn’t always translate to superior returns. Some cash-heavy businesses struggle with inefficient spending, slowing demand, or weak competitive positioning.
